info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking It Management Platform Operations-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking IT Management Platform Operations API provides access to the various operational components of a banking IT management system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about current platform operations, facilitating oversight and management tasks. Typical consumers of this API include IT administrators and business analysts seeking to monitor system performance and operational efficiency. The API is designed to support the effective management of banking IT resources and enhance operational decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve platform operations in IT management.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about various platform operations within the IT management system. It provides insights into current operations and their statuses, enabling better monitoring and decision-making.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving platform operations in IT management. This body should conform to the specified JSON schema to ensure proper processing of the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested platform operations.
